description: Whether a build can be sent to TestFlight (App Store signed .ipa) or a Google Play track (the kept .aab) and why not, the shared store app it would go to, and every send so far with its status (queued, sending, processing at Apple, finishing = waiting for Apple to process the build before the send options, sent, draft on Play production, failed) and the store answer. Each send lists the options the Admin picked (TestFlight What to Test, TestFlight groups and beta review on Team; Google Play release name, in-app update priority, changes not sent for review) and what happened to each. Sending and picking options is done by an Admin in the dashboard or with the CLI (appforshare store-upload, upload --store-upload), never from here. Read only. Pro and Team.
